_comment: Data for --kernel (Linux kernel version -> pin-state format). Edit freely; no code change needed. 'raw_base' is where reference files are fetched from (env KERNEL_RAW_BASE overrides it, e.g. an internal git mirror; the tag is appended as <raw_base>/<tag>/<path>). 'soc_reference' lists, per SoC, files in the kernel tree that contain pin-state nodes, tried in order. 'table' is the OFFLINE fallback: format rules MEASURED by reading the files named in 'evidence'; a version outside every measured range is not guessed.

rules.evidence: v5.15 and v6.1: 'usb2phy_ac_en1_default: usb2phy_ac_en1_default { mux { pins; function; bias; drive-strength; }; };'
v6.2, v6.3, v6.4, v6.5, v6.6, v6.12: 'usb2phy_ac_en1_default: usb2phy-ac-en1-default-state { pins; function; bias; drive-strength; };'
